steps.reply: ✅ Aap ki payment approve ho chuki hai aur wallet update ho gaya hai.
⏳ Aap ki payment verification process me hai. Kripya thora wait karein. Verification complete hote hi wallet automatically update ho jayega.
❌ Aap ki payment reject hui hai. Agar aap ko lagta hai ye mistake hai to payment screenshot aur Transaction ID bhej dein.
Payment record nahi mila. Kripya Transaction ID aur Payment Screenshot bhej dein.
